title: The Dawn of Civilization
summary: A prehistoric survival epic where sixteen-year-old Koda fights to turn a wandering tribe into a walled village that can survive. T. Stone's grounded historical fiction at its best.

title: The Richmond Cipher
summary: A historical thriller weaving cryptography, Civil War intrigue, and a family secret into a page-turning mystery by E. Maris.

title: Red Horizon: Lunar Launch
summary: A near-future lunar colony faces sabotage and political intrigue in this fast-paced sci-fi thriller by M. A. Hale.

title: The Confluence Doctrine
summary: In a world where suffering has been designed out, Orren Myal hears something that doesn't fit — a sense of 'full, but unfinished.'

title: Living with a Moving Planet
summary: Drawing on deep-time climate records and archaeology, this book shows how humans have adapted to changing baselines for tens of thousands of years. By J. T. Hartley.

title: Beyond the Veil
summary: A careful tour of evidence around what happens when we die, drawing on NDE research, quantum physics, and philosophy by D. E. Harlan.

title: Veiled Presence
summary: Researcher E. C. Stroud maps what can actually be supported by evidence in the modern UAP/UFO record — disciplined inquiry rather than enthusiasm.

title: The Power of Changing Your Mind
summary: In a culture that rewards confidence, this book shows how intellectual humility is actually a competitive edge — by Evan R. Cole.

title: The Shadow Within
summary: A practical, grounded guide to shadow work that avoids mysticism while acknowledging psychological depth — by Elena Maris.

title: Echoes of Aetheris
summary: Nine thousand years before history, a wounded alien ship falls onto a frozen steppe. The first hybrid is born — by Aetheri Codex.

title: Disclosure 2026
summary: Eighteen rated scenarios for what alien first contact could actually look like — from first signal to global aftermath. By Marcus Reeve.

title: Resonance Drift
summary: In Eden Prime's biolum spires, harmony hums — until a family detects a pulse that defies the weave. By R. Zyrion.

title: Symbiont Bloom
summary: On volcanic isles of Lumengrove, dawn arrives through living leaf-glass. When the island's pulse skips, a family must unravel a systems puzzle. By Elowen Tidebloom.

title: Otomí
summary: A historical narrative of land, ritual, and continuity — an Otomí community clinging to a shrinking lake in 10th century central Mexico highlands. By E. J. Marín.

title: Physics of Insight
summary: What if genius isn't rare — it's hidden inside every mind, waiting for the right switch? By Quantum Chronos.

title: Alien Disclosure 2026: The Year Everything Changed
summary: From David Grusch's testimony to Trump's February directive — the alleged hybrid breeding program, the Watchers, and what comes next for humanity.

title: The Disclosure
summary: A speech about infrastructure becomes something else entirely — when the President prepares to address a fractured nation on the night the world changes.
